findings.description: Uninitialized variables (h_found, h_direction, h_array, array_size, and segment_size) are used before being initialized.
Improper memory allocation size (cudaMalloc(&d_direction, (array_size / segment_size) * sizeof(int));) may allocate too little memory, leading to buffer overflows.
Unchecked return values (CUDA API calls) can lead to silent failures and undefined behavior.
Potential integer division by zero (segment_size is used as a divisor without checking if it is zero).
Potential out-of-bounds access (if array_size or segment_size are not properly validated, buffer overflows may occur).
